description: Reported the K unchanged and the Rose's bill.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Closed the afternoon and left the speech at the stable wall.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Refused the three farthings and went back to the cue.
name: Sam Latchet

description: Said term was ending and the gowns would thin.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Held the morning's courtesy and noted that Sam had taken no farthings.
name: Will Kemp

description: Named no part, kept the column numberless, and stayed.
name: William Shakespeare
